title: Show hours in formatDuration
description: `formatDuration` in `src/duration.js` writes long durations as a large number of minutes: two hours reads as `120m 0s`. Durations of an hour or more should read as hours, minutes and seconds, e.g. `1h 0m 0s` and `2h 2m 2s`. Durations under an hour are unchanged. `parseDuration` reads durations back, and other code relies on it reading everything `formatDuration` writes.
acceptance_criteria: durations under an hour format exactly as before
`parseDuration(formatDuration(n)) === n` for every non-negative integer `n`, hours included
notes: Also the M5 demonstration candidate (#386 sub-task B). reference/naive.patch changes formatDuration only; it fails the repository's own round-trip test (test/duration.test.js), so a maker that takes the naive route is caught by the repo, not by a model. reference/correct.patch passes both the repo's tests and the hidden test. Checked offline when this task was written.
